PF. 43817

CROSS-REFERENCE.

Subject:— HODANN, Max

4.1.36. Copy of departure card for Lise LINDBAEK-NILSSON dated 4.1.36. shows that she left England for Ostend three days after HODANN left on the expiration of his landing condition.

23.1.36. Above information sent to S.I.S.

Original in PF. 43824 77a, 78a dated 4.1.36. 23.1.36.

D.M.
85p.1.36.
